brief: Asymmetric, directional large-facet alternative. Native review must reject if diagonal energy intrudes into lockup safe area; V006 remains active ROM baseline.
prompt_constraints: Asymmetric large crystal group on upper-left and lower-left; only separated narrow shards at right.
Three broad diagonal energy streaks toward a compact lower ignition.
Large forms only; no microtexture, bloom, haze, gradients or checkerboard.
No text, logos, particles, characters, UI, watermark or copied IP.
translation_gate: Translate to native 320x224 indexed 4bpp on the Mega Drive 9-bit grid.
Inspect whether diagonal streaks intrude on the SGDK/FORGE safe area at native size.
Compare basic and curated palette against V006 and V008; measure H/V tiles.
Do not promote to /res or ROM without later human curation.
prompt: Revise this clean Mega Drive splash background concept to feel directional and asymmetric, while keeping its very dark central logo window and low detail density. This is only a BACKGROUND source, with no logos, no text, no particles, no interface. Do not mirror the crystal groups: place one stronger angular cluster entering from the upper-left edge and a smaller cluster near lower-left; on the right use only two or three narrower separated crystal shards, with more open gaps. Keep the middle 60 percent nearly black navy and empty for a large centered SGDK/FORGE lockup. Create a clear forward-motion direction with only three broad hard-edged blue/cyan energy streaks running diagonally from upper-left toward a compact ignition slightly right of bottom-center. Keep the ignition small and distinct; no broad glowing floor, no horizon glow. Preserve large coherent facets and unmistakable silhouettes at low resolution; no microtexture, no tiny sparkles, no haze, no bloom, no gradients, no checker patterns, no photographic finish. Use only deep navy, cobalt, royal blue, cyan and a few ice-blue highlights. Restrained 16-bit console art direction, native pixel translation friendly. The result must read clearly in a small 320x224 4:3 frame.
